title: Prop spec
description: Parametric definition of a placeable track prop. The Blender headless builder appends a kit part, scales/tints it, and writes public/assets/props/<id>.glb.

waveRider.description: When present, opts the prop into the runtime wave-rider system. The build pipeline stamps `wave_rider_archetype` extras on the prop root; the runtime spawns a kinematic body that tracks the wave surface and reacts to hits. Absent → static prop.

archetype.description: Picks the per-archetype tuning preset (floatOffsetY, springK, etc.) baked into game/components/wave-rider.ts. Add new archetypes there + here together.

kitPart.description: Name of the source object in tools/blender/lib/prop_kit.blend.

halfExtents.description: Box: [hx, hy, hz] in three.js axes [right, up, forward].
